name: Edge-Role Consistency Shift
description: Instead of asking the model to assign global states (transmitter/receiver) to vertices which implies a directed edge, this rewrite asks the model to assign asymmetric roles (provider/consumer) to the endpoints of each individual edge. The bipartite restriction is then enforced indirectly via a "uniformity rule" that requires each vertex to have the same role across all its incident edges. This breaks the direct pattern-match to vertex 2-coloring.
